lines.text: US and European labels follow ECIA: 1P is reportedly the part number, Q the quantity, 9D the date code, 1T the lot.
lines.say: U-S and European labels follow E-C-I-A: one-P is reportedly the part number, Q the quantity, nine-D the date code, one-T the lot.

lines.text: And 4L is the country of origin.
lines.say: And four-L is the country of origin.

lines.text: The date code is usually year and week. 2541 is week 41 of 2025.

title: JAPAN
DIFFERS.
visual.tag: NO D/C FIELD? CHECK THE LOT

lines.text: Some Japanese makers use the EIAJ C-3 format. The reel we checked had no separate date code field.
lines.say: Some Japanese makers use the E-I-A-J C-three format. The reel we checked had no separate date code field.

lines: So match the lot number to the certificate of conformance instead.
Then check the label against the parts: part number, origin, lot.

lines.text: ERAI flags barcodes that don't match the text, and odd fonts or spacing.
